preconditions.description: Input S is a non-empty string with length between 1 and 10,000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(S[i] == S[j] for i, j in zip(range(len(return_value)), range(len(return_value)-1, -1, -1)))
postconditions.description: The returned substring is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards).

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max(len(S[i:j+1]) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if all(S[k] == S[i+j-k] for k in range(i, j+1)))
postconditions.description: The returned substring is the longest possible palindrome in S. If multiple substrings have the same maximum length, the one with the smallest starting index is chosen.

postconditions.expression: return_value == S[i:i+len(return_value)] for i in range(len(S)) if len(return_value) == len(S[i:i+len(return_value)]) and all(S[k] == S[i+len(return_value)-1-k] for k in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The returned substring is a contiguous substring of S (i.e., S[i..j] where 0 ≤ i ≤ j < len(S)).
